'''Jallar Golin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] who served [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Born in the turbulent [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], Golin eventually joined the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he caught the attention of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Palpatine taught Golin how to control his hatred through the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and molded him into one of his Hands. Persistent in his goals and calculating in his methods, Golin made an effective [[operative]] for the Emperor. Palpatine later sent Golin on a mission to investigate a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yorgraxx]]. Once there, Golin surveyed the immediate area and tracked the disturbance to a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Fornayh's fortress|fortress]], where he confronted a mixed group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] personnel.

==Biography==
Jallar Golin was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] born in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Golin spent the early years of his life surviving as well as he could in the fringes of [[Galactic community|civilization]]. He eventually made his way to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he caught the attention of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Golin spent some time in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] before finally being trained by Palpatine in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] as one of his [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hands]]&mdash;an elite group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[operative]]s answerable only to the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].<ref name="Shadows" />

At some point shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Palpatine felt a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]] caused by the awakening of the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Quorlac Fornayh]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yorgraxx]]. Palpatine immediately summoned Golin to his personal chambers at the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] and instructed him to investigate the source of the disturbance and retrieve it. Golin traveled to Yorgraxx in a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and landed in a small valley twenty-five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the source of the disturbance, an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Fornayh's fortress|fortress]]. He exited his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and surveyed his immediate surroundings before returning to the shuttle's [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]]. Once there, he consulted a map display and a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] readout, and filled in details of the surrounding area. Using this, he was able to determine where the disturbance originated and the best way to reach it. Golin retrieved a modified [[22-B Nightfalcon]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] from his shuttle's cargo hold and departed eastward for the Sith base.<ref name="Shadows" />

As Golin approached the entrance to the base, he encountered a joint group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] personnel exiting the fortress. Believing the Imperials had captured the Rebels and were in command, he ordered one of them, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Arran Flekk]], to provide a situation report.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Report, Lieutenant.|Jallar Golin, to Arran Flekk|<ref name="Shadows" />}}
As a result of his upbringing, Jallar Golin harbored a great deal of hatred for most people. Emperor Palpatine encouraged this hatred, for while it made Golin slightly reckless, it also strengthened his ties to the dark side. He served Palpatine out of both devotion and fear, and shared a slight [[Force-bond/Legends|connection]] with his master through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. As an Emperor's Hand, Golin typically dressed in all [[black]] and was ruthless, arrogant, and capable. He was persistent in any task he was given and had an unbroken record of successes. He was surgical in his methods and believed that broad application of force was ineffective in most situations. Golin was a very paranoid individual and was suspicious of most people; he had a tendency to verify every piece of information given to him before stating it as fact and was unlikely to fall for any fabrication if he had reason to suspect the individual supplying him with information. Golin was very painstaking in his work, and to others he appeared menacing and exuded an air of authority.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Powers and abilities==
Jallar Golin was trained by Palpatine to channel his hatred through the dark side of the Force. He was adept at many [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]] in the realms of [[Force power/Legends#Control|Control]] and [[Force power/Legends#Alter|Alter]], including [[Mind trick/Legends|affect mind]], [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|Force strike]], [[Force healing/Legends|Force healing]], and [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]]. He was especially proficient in the [[Hatred]] ability,<ref name="Shadows" /> which allowed him to radiate hatred from his body in palpable waves against anyone close to him.<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> Golin also had extensive knowledge of [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] and was trained in the use of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]].<ref name="Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It is more powerful than I thought, and therefore it must be dealt with somehow. Vader, the Rebels can wait. I have need of you for another task &hellip;|Emperor Palpatine|<ref name="Shadows" />}}
Jallar Golin was created for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure ''[[Shadows in the Force]]'', written by [[Robert Wiese]] and released in [[2004]]. In the adventure, the players take on the roles of a mixed group of Rebels and Imperials stranded on Yorgraxx, and Golin's ultimate fate is determined entirely by their confrontation with him. The players must either talk or fight with him to resolve their situation, or simply flee. If they choose or are forced to fight him, Golin will attempt to distance himself from the players using his speeder bike and then proceed to use his [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] in conjunction with his Force powers against the players. If any of the players get close to him or he finds himself losing the battle, Golin uses his Hatred ability. If the situation becomes even more dire for him, he retreats and surreptitiously follows the players, striking only when their guard is down. If Golin is killed, Palpatine senses his [[Death/Legends|death]] through the Force and sends [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to continue the investigation on Yorgraxx in his place.<ref name="Shadows" />
